_note: The SpeedKills world's own numbers, whatever map it is on (src/game/world.ts, br.ts, edge.ts, padsolve.ts, atmosphere.ts): they lived in city.json with the old ILranch city's, which the owner had taken out on 2026-10-09 ("remove ILranch city completely"). The Neon City sets its sectors, its Spire top and its own air as it is built (neonmap.json game).
_cut: The map's half width, metres (br.ts BR_HALF on SpeedKills): 152 since Phase 23.3, the owner's cut of the outer districts by about three quarters ("CUT DOWN ON THE OTSIDE DISTRICTS TOO BY LIKE 75% BC WE WANT IT TO BE FOCUSED IN THE MIDDLE NOW"), the 304 m the Neon City is laid out to.
_edge: The city's edge (Phase 20 A4; src/game/edge.ts, city.ts, main.ts edgeFrame). margin: how far past the edge a body can go before a wall stops it, metres: the owner's about 40, held to 38 because the range's covered lane ends 39 to 40 m north of the city (its back wall at world z 210 to 211, measured off the range's solids in a match), which keeps a body a metre off it. countdown: the owner's 5 s outside before the death; a step back in stops it and the next time out starts from 5 again. gulag: an out-of-bounds first death goes to the Gulag as a ring death does. There was a red laser down on whoever stayed, with a red ring on the ground round them, on every screen; the owner took it out, 2026-09-28 ("remove the laser stuff completely and just have the user die with the explanation"): a red circle kept being seen round enemies, and this was the one thing in the game that drew one on a figure.

fence._line: The fence's lit lines, a metre apart, each `line` 256ths of their 8 m texture high (6 cm; 3 until Milestone 668, 9 cm: from a roof beside the fence the lines over the eye ran off as wide red bands, the districts' review, picture 12).

_padSolve: A jump pad onto a roof (city.ts padOnto), in metres: it stands standOff past a body's radius from the face, throws you straight up to peakOver above the roof, and once you are clear above the edge carries you across to land landInside past it. Ours, so a pad lands you on the roof with no steering; holding forward in the air still carries you further.
_neonGlow: How bright the edge fence's posts and strips burn (world.ts buildEdgeFence), and the arenas' neon (arenas/build.ts): an emissive's intensity.
_atmosphere: The air over the map (atmosphere.ts): `margin` metres past the map's edge it still holds, `ease` seconds to blend to its colour. Its colours, near and far are the map's own (neonmap.json game.air).
_arenaLook: NEON BLOCK's walls (arenas/build.ts look "city"): the night facade texture's tile, metres, and its windows' glow.

bloom._note: The post chain's bloom (src/game/render.ts, Balanced and High): its strength, radius and luminance threshold. The owner, 2026-10-18: "bloom is a big thing, we don't want that almost at all". It was 0.32, 0.5 and 0.95: the tower's ceiling lamps, THE CANYON's walkway lamps and THE STRIP's club blew out to white, named in two reviews in a row. Now only the brightest light glows, faintly, and gunfire barely.

_skyline: A city past the fence (Milestone 680; both fresh reviews of 2026-10-20 found the edge 'a tabletop floating in beige haze', and asked first for a city carried on past the wall), drawn only (src/game/skyline.ts): the ground carried on from `from` metres past the fence (where the map's own ground ends) out to `ground`, and tower blocks on a jittered grid of `cell` m squares from `inner` (past the out-of-bounds margin, cut.half + edge.margin = 190, with room to spare) to `outer`, each square filled by `fill`, `size` m across, `height` m tall, low by the fence and rising toward the horizon (from the 50 m lookout an even ring stood as one wall over the map's own towers), `tall` of those past `tall.from` of the way out taller (all under the dropship's 140 m, squad.json ship.height); `setback` of the others carry a block `scale` as wide on top, `height` of their own height, for a skyline's broken line. Their windows are worked out in the shader, a storey `storey` m and a bay `bay` m, `lit` of them lit in `warm` or `cool`, glowing `glow.night` by night and `glow.day` by day, through the map's own haze, and the far ones taken by it faster (`haze`, of the fog's colour at `outer`). Each block wears one of `bodies`. `seed` the same skyline on every page. `keep` [x0, x1, z0, z1] map metres the towers and the ground stay out of: the firing range's footprint (its solids measured in the game, world x -34.5 to 123 and z -122 to 195, up to 60 m: map z -622 to -305), 10 m round; it stands 153 m past the fence inside the ring, and the first skyline stood towers in its lanes.
